title: One-Sided Expert-Parallel All-to-All for Mixture-of-Experts Inference over NVLink
abstract: arXiv:2611.13188v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Expert parallelism (EP) shards the experts of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layer across GPUs, so every MoE layer requires two all-to-all communications, namely dispatch and combine. Compared with training, inference processes relatively few tokens per GPU at a time, and at small batch sizes fixed costs that do not grow with the number of tokens, rather than data movement, dominate the latency. We present NVLinkOneSided, a one-sided EP all-to-all for GPUs within a single NVLink domain. Each source rank pushes its tokens, without first exchanging metadata, into rank-major buffers on the target GPUs, and the grouped GEMMs read them in place instead of from a per-expert copy. We provide two protocols for the synchronization that the communication requires, namely Fence and Sentinel, for high-throughput and low-latency scenarios respectively. On Blackwell GPUs, NVLinkOneSided completes dispatch and combine 1.2-3.0$\times$ faster than DeepEP,

translated_title: 面向NVLink上混合专家推理的单边专家并行All-to-All通信
translated_abstract: 专家并行将混合专家层的专家分片到多个GPU上，因此每个MoE层需要两次all-to-all通信，即分发和组合。与训练相比，推理时每个GPU一次处理的token数量相对较少，在小批量规模下，主导延迟的是不随token数量增长的固定开销，而非数据移动本身。我们提出了NVLinkOneSided，一种面向单个NVLink域内GPU的单边EP all-to-all通信方法。每个源rank无需预先交换元数据，直接将其token推送到目标GPU上以rank为主组织的缓冲区中，分组GEMM则直接原地读取这些数据，而无需从按专家复制的副本中读取。我们为通信所需的同步提供了两种协议，即Fence和Sentinel，分别适用于高吞吐量和低延迟场景。在Blackwell GPU上，NVLinkOneSided完成分发和组合的速度比DeepEP快1.2-3.0倍。
tldr: NVLinkOneSided提出了一种面向NVLink域内混合专家推理的单边all-to-all通信方法，通过免元数据交换的直接推送、原地读取机制以及Fence和Sentinel两种同步协议，在Blackwell GPU上比DeepEP快1.2-3.0倍。
en_tdlr: NVLinkOneSided is a one-sided EP all-to-all communication method for MoE inference over NVLink, which achieves 1.2-3.0× faster dispatch and combine than DeepEP on Blackwell GPUs through metadata-free direct token pushing, in-place reading by grouped GEMMs, and two synchronization protocols (Fence and Sentinel).
